name: testglass
description: Generate a human-reviewable test specification (single-file HTML) from test code by static analysis

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "require('node:fs').cpSync('src/output/html/assets','dist/output/html/assets',{recursive:true})" && node dist/cli.js schema --out dist/schema.json
scripts.demo: npm run build && node dist/cli.js --root test/fixtures --out demo/spec.json
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
